chunk-001:c005.proposition: Evidence equally explained by non-God alternatives does not support God specifically, and naturalistic pantheism can accommodate the standard theistic arguments.

orphanFallback.rationale: Independently of any earlier opposing move, the rabbit-in-a-box analogy advances a general evidential principle: observations shared equally by several hypotheses do not discriminate among them.

chunk-001:c006.proposition: No known form of human knowledge justifies metaphysical stopping points or maximal divine properties, and unsupported properties can be assigned equally to alternatives.

orphanFallback.rationale: The move independently advances an epistemic limit argument across empirical, a priori, mathematical, logical, and moral knowledge while granting only an unspecified necessary ground.

chunk-001:c007.proposition: Unlimited metaphysical properties license arbitrary ad hoc explanations, while impersonal pantheism is simpler because it posits fewer properties than theism.

orphanFallback.rationale: The comparison independently supplies a parsimony argument: unrestricted attributes permit arbitrary repairs, whereas an account with fewer asserted personal and moral properties is more constrained.

chunk-001:c009.proposition: An all-good and all-powerful God would create a world without involuntary suffering, because any proposed sufficient reason for suffering could instead be made optional.

orphanFallback.rationale: This is already a positive constructive argument: allowing persons to choose any proposed benefit of suffering would produce a morally better world without imposing that suffering involuntarily.

chunk-002:c002-02.proposition: Emergent spacetime and quantum phenomena do not support a cosmic mind because natural emergence remains viable and consciousness-based quantum interpretations are scientifically marginal.

orphanFallback.rationale: The move independently offers natural emergence as an alternative account of spacetime and notes that consciousness-driven interpretations are minority positions among physicists.

chunk-003:c003-02.proposition: Digital-physics, observer-consciousness, and introspective considerations do not establish fundamental mind, while an undiscovered physical basis is more parsimonious than a new ontological category.

orphanFallback.rationale: As a standalone comparative inference, the move favors an undiscovered physical explanation over introducing an entirely new fundamental category of conscious reality.

chunk-003:c003-04.proposition: Inferring a fundamentally new kind of reality from an unexplained phenomenon is an argument from ignorance when past explanatory success supports expecting undiscovered natural causes.

orphanFallback.rationale: The historical analogy with once-unexplained lightning independently grounds an inductive expectation that another unknown natural cause is preferable to positing a new ontological category.

chunk-003:c003-09.proposition: Although the observable universe began with the Big Bang, a cyclic cosmos or multiverse could be infinite and occupy the same regress-ending explanatory role assigned to God.

orphanFallback.rationale: The distinction between the observable universe and ultimate reality independently supplies cyclic-cosmos and multiverse models as possible non-divine explanatory termini.

chunk-004:c004-03.proposition: A God or conscious entity is not a physical theory because physics contains no principle, particle, or law corresponding to such an entity.

orphanFallback.rationale: The move independently distinguishes physical models, which recombine recognized principles, particles, and laws, from a conscious-God hypothesis lacking a corresponding element in physics.

chunk-004:c004-09.proposition: A claim about the limits of justifiable human knowledge is not an unrestricted claim about all possible knowledge or reality and therefore is not self-refuting metaphysical absolutism.

orphanFallback.rationale: The move independently draws a substantive scope distinction: a supportable claim about human justification is narrower than an absolute claim covering every possible knower or feature of reality.
